response.overview: The "Grundstück" DVD by Einstürzende Neubauten was originally released in 2005 as an exclusive for participants in their second "Supporter" phase. In September 2018, it was officially released for general retail for the first time, bundled with the album. The DVD primarily documents a special concert/recording session held on November 3, 2004, with fan participation. It features live recordings and visual content—including tracks such as "Nagorny Karabach" and "Ein leichtes leises"—as well as a hidden/chapter-based track titled "Was IST IST." Additionally, it includes commentary from the band and previously unreleased audio material
response.title: Einstürzende Neubauten: Grundstueck
